# ConvoTrack

> ConvoTrack is a group ride tracking app for iPhone (Android coming soon). It puts every rider in a group on one live map, gives everyone turn-by-turn voice navigation to the destination, lets any rider call a regroup or an emergency alert in one tap, and produces a ride summary at the end. It is built for motorcycle group rides, road trips and vehicle convoys.

## Key facts

- Platforms: iPhone, on the App Store (https://apps.apple.com/in/app/convotrack/id6788236830). Android is coming to Google Play.
- Price: free to download. ConvoTrack Pro is an optional upgrade for bigger groups and full ride history.
- Sign-in: Apple or Google. Riders join a ride with an invite link, a QR code or a 6-character code.
- Privacy: location is shared only while a ride is live, only with riders in the same ride, and stops when the ride ends or the rider leaves. Location data is not sold or used for advertising.

## Features

- Live group map: every rider's position and distance, riders off screen pinned to the map edge, alerts when the group splits too far apart.
- Turn-by-turn voice navigation for every rider.
- Ride planner: destination search, route choice and stops.
- Regroup: one tap to call a fuel, food or scenic stop, with a meet point for the whole group.
- Emergency alerts: an urgent broadcast to the group with the rider's location.
- Rider roles: Ride Leader, Pace Keeper, Trail Guardian, Formation Rider.
- Lobby with a ready check before the ride starts.
- Ride summary: total distance, duration, average speed, max group split and final order, shareable as a card.
- Shareable routes that another group can ride.
